{{*}} [[Dead Can Dance]] (Classic mode) |map = {{Map|name=Graveyard of Shadows|x=3164|y=3672|height=300|width=300|zoom=2}} |leagueRegion = Wilderness }} {{Relativelocation |location = Graveyard of Shadows |north = Ruins (east) |west = Dark Warriors' Fortress |south = Ferox Enclave |east = Chaos Temple (Wilderness) }} The '''Graveyard of Shadows,''' located at levels 18–21 in the [[Wilderness]], occupies a section of what was once the [[Zarosian Empire|Zarosian fortress]] of [[Carrallanger]]. This area is a large, seemingly forgotten graveyard filled with [[dead tree]]s, wandering [[zombie]]s, and derelict gravestones. Within the graveyard lies the [[Skeletal Tomb]], the lair of [[Calvar'ion]]. ==Transportation== * [[Carrallanger Teleport]], part of [[Ancient Magicks]], goes directly to the graveyard. * Run north from [[Ferox Enclave]]. ==Item spawns== The graveyard features many item spawns. There are 5 [[plank]]s, 4 [[tile]]s, a [[crossbow]], an [[iron dagger]], a [[steel dagger]], and an [[iron med helm]] spawn. ==Treasure Trails== Digging directly under the [[crossbow]] respawn in level 18 Wilderness is the solution to a hard [[cryptic clue]]: ''[[Clue scroll (hard) - I lie lonely and forgotten in mid wilderness|I lie lonely and forgotten in mid wilderness, where the dead rise from their beds. Feel free to quarrel and wind me up and dig while you shoot their heads.]]'' {{Wilderness}} {{Burial sites}}
